projects.name: UniData
projects.description: Decentralized marketplace enabling secure, verifiable data trading with smart-contract automated escrow and IPFS content addressable storage.

modal_details.overview: UniData bridges AI researchers and data providers through trustless blockchain transactions.
modal_details.problem: Traditional data marketplaces suffer from high platform fees, centralized data censorship, and lack of verifiable provenance.
modal_details.architecture: Smart contracts handle dataset tokenization & escrow. File metadata is cryptographically pinned on IPFS with encryption keys delivered post-payment.
modal_details.challenges: Gas optimization for bulk dataset purchases and handling asymmetric key exchange on-chain.

projects.name: Neural-Ledger
projects.description: High-throughput backend engine that automatically detects, retries, and reconciles out-of-order or failed webhooks across distributed microservices.

modal_details.overview: Designed to guarantee eventual consistency and zero data loss for critical transactional events.
modal_details.problem: Third-party webhook failures and network partitions often lead to state drift between payment gateways and internal systems.
modal_details.architecture: Distributed dead-letter queue with exponential backoff algorithm, state reconciliation daemon, and real-time observability dashboard.
modal_details.challenges: Preventing duplicate processing during network recovery using idempotent key tracking in Redis.

projects.name: NyxEquities
projects.description: Next-gen trading interface for 24/7 tokenized asset execution, featuring real-time orderbooks and synthetic liquidity pools.

modal_details.overview: Brings traditional stock market assets onto public ledgers with instant settlement capabilities.
modal_details.problem: Legacy financial markets operate on limited 9-to-5 market hours with multi-day settlement cycles (T+2).
modal_details.architecture: Hybrid order matching engine off-chain with state proof submission on-chain via WebSockets for sub-second latency.
modal_details.challenges: Managing real-time orderbook synchronization across concurrent browser clients without UI re-render jitter.
